name: Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program (OINP)
name_fr: Programme ontarien des candidats à l'immigration
description: Skilled-worker streams of the Ontario Immigrant Nominee Program (OINP) and whether they run through Express Entry (an Express Entry-aligned nomination adds 600 CRS points).

attributes.legal_status: in force on the access date (provincial programme under a federal–provincial agreement)

skilled_worker_streams.summary: New stream from the June 2026 redesign; with a job offer in TEER 0–3 or as a self-employed physician, nomination can go through Express Entry

attributes.express_entry_aligned: Yes for Ontario Workforce Priority applicants with a TEER 0–3 job offer or self-employed physicians
attributes.notes: The redesign (Ontario Regulation 422/17 amended 26 June 2026) closed eight former streams, including the Employer Job Offer streams, Masters/PhD Graduate streams, Human Capital Priorities, French-Speaking Skilled Worker and Skilled Trades (one checklist page says Human Capital Priorities closed 30 May 2026 — dates conflict). Earnings-history scoring factor changed 5 October 2026.
attributes.status_dependency: Eligibility depends on occupation (NOC/TEER), job offer, language scores and existing ties to the province — all unknown (USER-PROFILE.md; OPEN-QUESTIONS.md items 2, 4, 7).

verification.notes: Read through search-engine extracts of the provincial programme's official pages, not fetched in full.

limitations: Stream rules change several times a year and intake is often by invitation only; read the provincial guide in force before applying.
